reports.title: Guide
reports.query:
This NeoDash report lets you browse the **Controlled Terminology** - both CDISC and Sponsor Codelists / Terms - and see how each Codelist and its Terms have evolved from Package to Package, and where a Term is used.

The tab **Codelist and Terms** uses a drill-down approach:
- optionally choose a **CT Type** to narrow the list of Codelists: a CT catalogue, or **Sponsor** for the Codelists owned by the Sponsor library (typically not part of a CT Package); leave it empty to search all
- search for and select a Codelist by name in **Pick a Codelist** - the other cards stay empty until you do
- **Codelist ID** shows the Codelist's C-code (CDISC) - or its name for a Sponsor Codelist, which has no C-code
- **Select CT Package** lists the versions of the Codelist with its **CT Type** (the catalogue, whether CDISC or Sponsor owned), **Owner** (the owning library, e.g. CDISC or Sponsor) and **Package**; if you set the **CT Type** filter, only the versions matching it are listed. Click a row to choose a CT Package and Version
- **Overview at Date** shows the Codelist's Terms as a graph. For a Codelist in a CT Package it shows the Terms as they stood in the selected Package; for a Codelist without a Package (Package shows '(none)') it shows the Terms currently in the Codelist
- **Terms in Codelist** lists the same Terms as a table, with C-code, Preferred Term, Synonyms, Definition, Term Version, Status and Start Date. For a Codelist that is not part of a CT Package (Package shows '(none)'), it lists the Terms currently in the Codelist - these two cards are the only ones that depend on the selected Package; the cards below work for every Codelist and look across all Packages
- **Terms History for Codelist** lists every Term recorded for the Codelist across all Packages, with **#Changes**, **Creation Date**, **Date of Change(s)**, **Retire Date** and **Status** (active / retired / replaced / removed). When a Term's Submission Value was changed, the old and the new Submission Value are listed as two rows: **Replaced by** on the old one and **Replaces** on the new one name the other value and the date of the change, and **In Codelist** shows the period each value was in the Codelist
- **History of terms in Codelist** plots every version of every Term in the Codelist, across all Packages, on a timeline; tick one or more Terms' **Submission Value** in the table above to show only those (ticking one Term also selects any other Term row sharing the same Submission Value). A Term whose Submission Value was changed is plotted as one chain of bars: each Submission Value's bars are limited to the period it was in the Codelist, labelled with that value and the Term's C-code, and an arrow leads from the old to the new one
- **Details for Term(s)** shows the attributes of the ticked Term(s), one row per version across all Packages. If a ticked Term had its Submission Value changed, the rows for the earlier and the later Submission Value are both shown, with **In Codelist** giving the period, and the changed Submission Value is highlighted in red
- **Term(s) used in** shows where the ticked Term(s) are used in this Codelist, regardless of Package, for example in Activity Items or in ODM Items on Forms and Item Groups. Usage belongs to the Term, not to a Term version, so the same usage is listed under every version; a Term that is not used shows 'Not used'

reports.title: Overview at Date : $neodash_pck_date
reports.query:
MATCH (ct_package:CTPackage) WHERE ct_package.name = $neodash_pck_date
MATCH
  (n1:CTCodelistAttributesValue)<-[r1:HAS_VERSION]-
  (n2:CTCodelistAttributesRoot)<-[r2]-
  (n3:CTCodelistRoot),
  (n3)<-[r3:HAS_CODELIST]-
  (catalogue:CTCatalogue)-[r4:CONTAINS_PACKAGE]->
  (ct_package)-[r5:CONTAINS_CODELIST]->
  (ct_pack_cl:CTPackageCodelist)-[r6:CONTAINS_TERM]->
  (ct_pack_term:CTPackageTerm)-[r7:CONTAINS_ATTRIBUTES]->
  (n8:CTTermAttributesValue),
  (ct_pack_cl)-[r8:CONTAINS_ATTRIBUTES]->(n1),
  (n3)<-[r9:CONTAINS_CODELIST]-(lib_cl:Library)
WHERE n1.name = $neodash_ctcodelistattributesvalue_name AND r1.version = $neodash_cl_id
MATCH
  (n3)-[r10:HAS_TERM]->
  (subm_val:CTCodelistTerm)<-[r11:CONTAINS_SUBMISSION_VALUE]-(ct_pack_term),
  (subm_val)-[r12:HAS_TERM_ROOT]->(n6:CTTermRoot)-[r13:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->
  (n7:CTTermAttributesRoot)-[r14:HAS_VERSION]->(n8)
MATCH (n6)<-[r16:CONTAINS_TERM]-(lib_term:Library)
RETURN DISTINCT
  n1, n2, n3, n6, n7, n8, subm_val, catalogue, ct_package, ct_pack_cl, ct_pack_term, lib_cl, lib_term,
  r1, r2, r3, r4, r5, r6, r7, r8, r9, r10, r11, r12, r13, r14, r16

UNION

MATCH
  (n1:CTCodelistAttributesValue)<-[r1:HAS_VERSION]-
  (n2:CTCodelistAttributesRoot)<-[r2]-
  (n3:CTCodelistRoot)
WHERE $neodash_pck_date = '(none)'
  AND n1.name = $neodash_ctcodelistattributesvalue_name AND r1.version = $neodash_cl_id
  AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (:CTPackageCodelist)-[:CONTAINS_ATTRIBUTES]->(n1) }
MATCH (n3)<-[r9:CONTAINS_CODELIST]-(lib_cl:Library)
MATCH
  (n3)-[r10:HAS_TERM]->(subm_val:CTCodelistTerm)-[r12:HAS_TERM_ROOT]->
  (n6:CTTermRoot)-[r13:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->
  (n7:CTTermAttributesRoot)-[r14:HAS_VERSION]->(n8:CTTermAttributesValue)
WHERE r10.end_date IS NULL AND r14.end_date IS NULL
MATCH (n6)<-[r16:CONTAINS_TERM]-(lib_term:Library)
RETURN DISTINCT
  n1, n2, n3, n6, n7, n8, subm_val,
  n1 AS catalogue, n1 AS ct_package, n1 AS ct_pack_cl, n1 AS ct_pack_term, lib_cl, lib_term,
  r1, r2, r1 AS r3, r1 AS r4, r1 AS r5, r1 AS r6, r1 AS r7, r1 AS r8, r9, r10, r1 AS r11, r12, r13, r14, r16

reports.title: History of terms in Codelist
reports.query:
CALL apoc.when( size($neodash_subval) > 0, "MATCH (n1:CTCodelistAttributesValue)<-[:HAS_VERSION]-(:CTCodelistAttributesRoot)<-[]-(n3:CTCodelistRoot)-[r10:HAS_TERM]->(subm_val:CTCodelistTerm)-[:HAS_TERM_ROOT]->(n6:CTTermRoot) WHERE n1.name=$neodash_ctcodelistattributesvalue_name AND EXISTS { MATCH (n3)-[:HAS_TERM]->(sel:CTCodelistTerm)-[:HAS_TERM_ROOT]->(n6) WHERE sel.submission_value IN $neodash_subval } WITH n3, n6, subm_val, r10 ORDER BY r10.start_date WITH n3, n6, subm_val, collect({s: r10.start_date, e: r10.end_date}) AS ivs WITH n6, subm_val, reduce(acc = [], iv IN ivs | CASE WHEN size(acc) > 0 AND (acc[-1].e IS NULL OR iv.s <= acc[-1].e) THEN acc[0..size(acc)-1] + [{s: acc[-1].s, e: CASE WHEN acc[-1].e IS NULL OR iv.e IS NULL THEN null WHEN iv.e > acc[-1].e THEN iv.e ELSE acc[-1].e END}] ELSE acc + [iv] END) AS periods UNWIND periods AS m WITH n6, subm_val, m.s AS sv_start, m.e AS sv_end MATCH (n6)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->(:CTTermAttributesRoot)-[r7:HAS_VERSION]->(n8:CTTermAttributesValue) WHERE coalesce(r7.end_date, datetime('9999-12-31T00:00:00Z')) > sv_start AND r7.start_date < coalesce(sv_end, datetime('9999-12-31T00:00:00Z')) with DISTINCT elementId(n6) as term, n6.concept_id as ccode, r7.version as version, properties(n8) as map1,apoc.map.fromValues(['submission_value',subm_val.submission_value,'version',r7.version,'start_date',CASE WHEN sv_start > r7.start_date THEN sv_start ELSE r7.start_date END,'retire_date',r7.end_date,'end_date',CASE WHEN sv_end IS NOT NULL AND (r7.end_date IS NULL OR sv_end < r7.end_date) THEN sv_end ELSE r7.end_date END]) as map2 order by map2.start_date, version with term, ccode, CASE WHEN 'synonyms' in keys(map1) THEN apoc.map.setValues(map1,['synonyms',apoc.text.join(map1['synonyms'],';')]) ELSE map1 END as map1, map2 with term, ccode, collect(apoc.map.merge(map1, map2)) as terms with term, ccode, size(terms) as n, terms with term, ccode, CASE WHEN n>1 THEN apoc.coll.pairs(terms) ELSE [[null,terms[0]]] end as terms with term, ccode, CASE when size(terms)>1 THEN apoc.coll.insert(terms[0..size(terms)-1], 0, [null,terms[0][0]]) ELSe terms END as terms WITH term, ccode, terms, [t in terms | CASE WHEN t[0] is not null and not t[0]['definition']=t[1]['definition'] THEN \"

V\" +t[0]['version']+ \": \" + t[0]['definition'] + \"

V\"+t[1]['version']+\": \" + t[1]['definition'] +\"

\" ELSE t[1]['definition'] end] as definition, [t in terms | t[1]['start_date']] as start_date, [t in terms | coalesce(t[1]['end_date'],date())] as end_date, [t in terms | CASE WHEN t[0] is not null and not t[0]['concept_id']=t[1]['concept_id'] THEN \"

V\"+t[1]['version']+\": \" + t[1]['concept_id'] +\"

\" ELSE t[1]['concept_id'] end] as concept_id, [t in terms | CASE WHEN t[0] is not null and not t[0]['retire_date']=t[1]['retire_date'] THEN \"

V\"+t[0]['version']+\": \" + apoc.temporal.format(t[0]['retire_date'],'yyyy-MM-dd') + \"

V\"+t[0]['version']+\": \" + t[0]['preferred_term'] + \"

V\"+t[1]['version']+\": \" + t[1]['preferred_term'] +\"

V\"+t[0]['version']+\": \" + t[0]['synonyms'] + \"

V\"+t[1]['version']+\": \"+ t[1]['synonyms'] + \"

retire_date, version, range(0,size(terms)-1,1) AS coll_size unwind coll_size as idx with distinct term, ccode,definition[idx] as definition, concept_id[idx] as concept_id, submission_value[idx] as submission_value, preferred_term[idx] as preferred_term, synonyms[idx] as synonyms, start_date[idx] as start_date, end_date[idx] as end_date, retire_date[idx] as retire_date, version[idx] as version WITH term, ccode, definition,concept_id,submission_value,preferred_term, synonyms,start_date, end_date, retire_date,version CALL apoc.create.vNode(['Term'], {start_date:apoc.temporal.format(start_date,'yyyy-MM-dd'), end_date:apoc.temporal.format(end_date,'yyyy-MM-dd'), retire_date:retire_date, concept_id: concept_id, submission_value:submission_value, reports.title: Terms History for Codelist - $neodash_ctcodelistattributesvalue_name
reports.query:
MATCH
  (n1:CTCodelistAttributesValue)<-[r1:HAS_VERSION]-
  (n2:CTCodelistAttributesRoot)<-[r2]-
  (n3:CTCodelistRoot)
WHERE n1.name = $neodash_ctcodelistattributesvalue_name
MATCH (n3)<-[r9:CONTAINS_CODELIST]-(lib_cl:Library)
MATCH
  (n3)-[r10:HAS_TERM]->(subm_val:CTCodelistTerm)-[r12:HAS_TERM_ROOT]->
  (n6:CTTermRoot)-[r13:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->
  (n7:CTTermAttributesRoot)-[r14:HAS_VERSION]->(n8:CTTermAttributesValue)
MATCH (n6)<-[r16:CONTAINS_TERM]-(lib_term:Library)
WITH DISTINCT
  n1.name AS CodelistName,
  lib_cl.name AS CodelistOwner,
  n3.uid AS Codelist,
  subm_val.submission_value AS SubVal,
  elementId(n6) AS TermKey,
  n8.concept_id AS `Term C-code`,
  lib_term.name AS TermOwner,
  r10.start_date AS sv_start,
  r10.end_date AS sv_end,
  CASE
    WHEN r14.start_date IS NOT NULL THEN format(r14.start_date, "yyyy-MM-dd")
    ELSE ''
  END AS start_date,
  r14.status AS v_status,
  r14.end_date IS NULL AS v_open
WITH
  CodelistName,
  CodelistOwner,
  Codelist,
  SubVal,
  TermKey,
  TermOwner,
  `Term C-code`,
  collect(DISTINCT start_date) AS startDates,
  collect(DISTINCT {d: start_date, st: v_status, o: v_open}) AS versions,
  collect(DISTINCT {s: sv_start, e: sv_end}) AS ivsRaw
WITH DISTINCT
  Codelist,
  CodelistName,
  CodelistOwner,
  `Term C-code`,
  SubVal,
  TermKey,
  TermOwner,
  size(startDates) - 1 AS numChange,
  coll.sort(startDates) AS startDate,
  reduce(
    best = null, v IN versions
    | CASE
        WHEN best IS NULL OR v.d > best.d OR (v.d = best.d AND v.o AND NOT best.o)
          THEN v
        ELSE best
      END
  ) AS latest,
  ivsRaw
UNWIND ivsRaw AS iv
WITH
  Codelist,
  CodelistName,
  CodelistOwner,
  `Term C-code`,
  SubVal,
  TermKey,
  TermOwner,
  numChange,
  startDate,
  latest,
  iv
ORDER BY iv.s
WITH
  Codelist,
  CodelistName,
  CodelistOwner,
  `Term C-code`,
  SubVal,
  TermKey,
  TermOwner,
  numChange,
  startDate,
  latest,
  collect(iv) AS ivs
UNWIND reduce(acc = [], iv IN ivs | CASE WHEN size(acc) > 0 AND (acc[-1].e IS NULL OR iv.s <= acc[-1].e) THEN acc[0..size(acc)-1] + [{s: acc[-1].s, e: CASE WHEN acc[-1].e IS NULL OR iv.e IS NULL THEN null WHEN iv.e > acc[-1].e THEN iv.e ELSE acc[-1].e END}] ELSE acc + [iv] END) AS p
WITH
  Codelist,
  CodelistName,
  CodelistOwner,
  `Term C-code`,
  SubVal,
  TermKey,
  TermOwner,
  numChange,
  startDate,
  latest,
  p.s AS svStart,
  p.e AS svEnd
WITH collect({
  cl: Codelist,
  name: CodelistName,
  owner: CodelistOwner,
  cc: `Term C-code`,
  sv: SubVal,
  key: TermKey,
  towner: TermOwner,
  n: numChange,
  sd: startDate,
  lat: latest,
  s: svStart,
  e: svEnd
}) AS allRows
UNWIND allRows AS a
WITH
  a,
  [
    b IN allRows
    WHERE b.cl = a.cl AND b.key = a.key AND b.sv <> a.sv AND a.e IS NOT NULL AND
      b.s >= a.e
  ] AS successors,
  [
    b IN allRows
    WHERE b.cl = a.cl AND b.key = a.key AND b.sv <> a.sv AND b.e IS NOT NULL AND
      b.e <= a.s
  ] AS predecessors
WITH
  a,
  reduce(
    best = null, b IN successors
    | CASE WHEN best IS NULL OR b.s < best.s THEN b ELSE best END
  ) AS nxt,
  reduce(
    best = null, b IN predecessors
    | CASE WHEN best IS NULL OR b.e > best.e THEN b ELSE best END
  ) AS prv
RETURN
  a.cl AS Codelist,
  a.owner AS CodelistOwner,
  a.name AS `Codelist Name`,
  a.cc AS `Term C-code`,
  a.sv AS `Submission Value`,
  CASE
    WHEN prv IS NOT NULL
      THEN prv.sv + ' (' + apoc.temporal.format(a.s, 'yyyy-MM-dd') + ')'
    ELSE ''
  END AS Replaces,
  CASE
    WHEN nxt IS NOT NULL
      THEN nxt.sv + ' (' + apoc.temporal.format(a.e, 'yyyy-MM-dd') + ')'
    ELSE ''
  END AS `Replaced by`,
  CASE
    WHEN a.s IS NULL THEN ''
    WHEN a.e IS NULL THEN 'from ' + apoc.temporal.format(a.s, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
    ELSE
      apoc.temporal.format(a.s, 'yyyy-MM-dd') + ' to ' +
      apoc.temporal.format(a.e, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
  END AS `In Codelist`,
  a.towner AS TermOwner,
  a.n AS `#Changes`,
  a.sd[0] AS `Creation Date`,
  CASE
    WHEN size(a.sd) > 1 THEN string.join(a.sd[1..(size(a.sd))], ', ')
    ELSE ''
  END AS `Date of Change(s)`,
  CASE WHEN toLower(toString(a.lat.st)) = 'retired' THEN a.lat.d ELSE '' END
    AS `Retire Date`,
  CASE
    WHEN toLower(toString(a.lat.st)) = 'retired' THEN 'retired'
    WHEN a.e IS NOT NULL THEN
      CASE WHEN nxt IS NOT NULL THEN 'replaced' ELSE 'removed' END
    ELSE 'active'
  END AS Status
ORDER BY Codelist, `Codelist Name`, `Submission Value`, a.s

reports.title: Details for Term(s): $neodash_subval
reports.query:
//codelist_term_history
MATCH
  (n1:CTCodelistAttributesValue)<-[:HAS_VERSION]-
  (:CTCodelistAttributesRoot)<-[]-
  (n3:CTCodelistRoot)-[:HAS_TERM]->
  (sel:CTCodelistTerm)-[:HAS_TERM_ROOT]->(n6:CTTermRoot)
WHERE n1.name = $neodash_ctcodelistattributesvalue_name
AND sel.submission_value IN $neodash_subval
WITH DISTINCT n3, n6
MATCH (n3)-[r10:HAS_TERM]->(subm_val:CTCodelistTerm)-[:HAS_TERM_ROOT]->(n6)
WITH n3, n6, subm_val, r10
ORDER BY r10.start_date
WITH n3, n6, subm_val, collect({s: r10.start_date, e: r10.end_date}) AS ivs
WITH
  n6,
  subm_val,
  reduce(acc = [], iv IN ivs | CASE WHEN size(acc) > 0 AND (acc[-1].e IS NULL OR iv.s <= acc[-1].e) THEN acc[0..size(acc)-1] + [{s: acc[-1].s, e: CASE WHEN acc[-1].e IS NULL OR iv.e IS NULL THEN null WHEN iv.e > acc[-1].e THEN iv.e ELSE acc[-1].e END}] ELSE acc + [iv] END) AS periods
UNWIND periods AS m
WITH
  n6,
  subm_val,
  m.s AS sv_start,
  m.e AS sv_end
MATCH
  (n6)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->(:CTTermAttributesRoot)-[r7:HAS_VERSION]->
  (n8:CTTermAttributesValue)
WHERE
  coalesce(r7.end_date, datetime('9999-12-31T00:00:00Z')) > sv_start
  AND r7.start_date < coalesce(sv_end, datetime('9999-12-31T00:00:00Z'))
WITH DISTINCT
  elementId(n6) AS term_key,
  apoc.map.merge(
    properties(n8),
    apoc.map.fromValues([
      'submission_value',
       subm_val.submission_value,
      'version',
      r7.version,
      'start_date',
      r7.start_date,
      'retire_date',
      r7.end_date,
      'end_date',
      r7.end_date,
      'cl_start',
      sv_start,
      'cl_end',
      sv_end
    ])
  ) AS term
ORDER BY term.cl_start, term.version
WITH term_key, collect(term) AS terms
WITH
  term_key,
  CASE
    WHEN size(terms) = 1 THEN [[null, terms[0]]]
    ELSE apoc.coll.pairs(terms)
  END AS terms
WITH
  term_key,
  CASE
    WHEN size(terms) = 1 THEN terms
    ELSE apoc.coll.insert(terms[0..size(terms) - 1], 0, [null, terms[0][0]])
  END AS terms
WITH
  term_key,
  terms,
  [
    p IN terms
    | CASE
      WHEN
        (p[0]['definition'] = p[1]['definition']) OR p[0]['definition'] IS NULL
        THEN 'no'
      ELSE 'yes'
    END
  ] AS def_diff,
  [
    p IN terms
    | CASE
      WHEN
        (p[0]['submission_value'] = p[1]['submission_value']) OR
        p[0]['submission_value'] IS NULL
        THEN 'no'
      ELSE 'yes'
    END
  ] AS subval_diff,
  [
    p IN terms
    | CASE
      WHEN
        (p[0]['preferred_term'] = p[1]['preferred_term']) OR
        p[0]['preferred_term'] IS NULL
        THEN 'no'
      ELSE 'yes'
    END
  ] AS pref_term_diff,
  [
    p IN terms
    | CASE
      WHEN
        (p[0]['concept_id'] = p[1]['concept_id']) OR p[0]['concept_id'] IS NULL
        THEN 'no'
      ELSE 'yes'
    END
  ] AS concept_diff,
  [
    p IN terms
    | CASE
      WHEN
        (p[0]['synonyms'] = p[1]['synonyms']) OR p[0]['synonyms'] IS NULL
        THEN 'no'
      ELSE 'yes'
    END
  ] AS sym_diff
WITH
  term_key,
  terms,
  def_diff,
  subval_diff,
  pref_term_diff,
  concept_diff,
  sym_diff,
  range(0, size(terms) - 1, 1) AS coll_size
UNWIND coll_size AS idx
WITH
  term_key,
  terms[idx][1] AS term,
  def_diff[idx] AS def_diff,
  subval_diff[idx] AS subval_diff,
  pref_term_diff[idx] AS pref_term_diff,
  concept_diff[idx] AS concept_diff,
  sym_diff[idx] AS sym_diff
WITH
  term_key,
  CASE
    WHEN "submission_value" IN keys(term) THEN term.submission_value
    ELSE null
  END AS `Submission Value`,
  CASE
    WHEN 'concept_id' IN keys(term) THEN term.concept_id
    ELSE null
  END AS `C-code`,
  CASE
    WHEN "preferred_term" IN keys(term) THEN term.preferred_term
    ELSE null
  END AS `Preferred Term`,
  CASE
    WHEN "synonyms" IN keys(term) THEN term.synonyms
    ELSE null
  END AS Synonyms,
  CASE
    WHEN "definition" IN keys(term) THEN term.definition
    ELSE null
  END AS Definition,
  CASE
    WHEN
      term.start_date IS NOT NULL
      THEN apoc.temporal.format(term.start_date, "yyyy-MM-dd")
    ELSE null
  END AS `Start Date`,
  CASE
    WHEN
      term.end_date IS NOT NULL
      THEN apoc.temporal.format(term.end_date, "yyyy-MM-dd")
    ELSE null
  END AS end_date,
  CASE
    WHEN
      term.retire_date IS NOT NULL
      THEN apoc.temporal.format(term.retire_date, "yyyy-MM-dd")
    ELSE null
  END AS `Retire Date`,
  CASE
    WHEN term.cl_start IS NULL THEN ''
    WHEN term.cl_end IS NULL
      THEN 'from ' + apoc.temporal.format(term.cl_start, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
    ELSE
      apoc.temporal.format(term.cl_start, 'yyyy-MM-dd') + ' to ' +
      apoc.temporal.format(term.cl_end, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
  END AS `In Codelist`,
  term.cl_start AS cl_start,
  term.version AS Version,
  def_diff,
  subval_diff,
  pref_term_diff,
  concept_diff,
  sym_diff
RETURN
  `Start Date`,
  coalesce(end_date, `Retire Date`) AS `End Date`,
  Version,
  `Submission Value`,
  `In Codelist`,
  `C-code`,
  `Preferred Term`,
  Synonyms,
  Definition,
  subval_diff AS __subval_diff,
  concept_diff AS __concept_diff,
  pref_term_diff AS __pref_term_diff,
  sym_diff AS __sym_diff,
  def_diff AS __def_diff
ORDER BY term_key, cl_start, `Start Date`, `End Date`

reports.title: Select CT Package
reports.query:
MATCH
  (n1:CTCodelistAttributesValue)<-[r1:HAS_VERSION]-
  (n2:CTCodelistAttributesRoot)<-[r2]-
  (n3:CTCodelistRoot),
  (n3)<-[r11:HAS_CODELIST]-
  (catalogue:CTCatalogue)
OPTIONAL MATCH (catalogue)-[r12:CONTAINS_PACKAGE]->
  (package:CTPackage)-[r13:CONTAINS_CODELIST]->
  (cl_package:CTPackageCodelist)-[r14:CONTAINS_ATTRIBUTES]->
  (n1)
OPTIONAL MATCH (n3)<-[:CONTAINS_CODELIST]-(lib:Library)
WITH DISTINCT n1, r1, package, catalogue, coalesce(lib.name, '') AS owner
WHERE n1.name = $neodash_ctcodelistattributesvalue_name
  AND (
    coalesce($neodash_ctcatalogue_name, '') = ''
    OR ($neodash_ctcatalogue_name = 'Sponsor' AND owner = 'Sponsor')
    OR ($neodash_ctcatalogue_name <> 'Sponsor' AND catalogue.name = $neodash_ctcatalogue_name)
  )
RETURN  
catalogue.name as `CT Type`,
owner as Owner,
coalesce(package.name, '(none)') as Package,
n1.name AS Codelist,
r1.version as Version,
CASE WHEN r1.end_date is not null THEN apoc.text.join([apoc.temporal.format(r1.start_date,"yyyy-MM-dd"), apoc.temporal.format(r1.end_date,"yyyy-MM-dd")],'') ELSE apoc.text.join([apoc.temporal.format(r1.start_date,"yyyy-MM-dd"), ''],'-') END as Date,
elementId(n1) as __id
 order by `CT Type`, Package DESC , Version DESC

reports.title: Term(s) used in
reports.query:
MATCH
  (n1:CTCodelistAttributesValue)<-[r1:HAS_VERSION]-
  (n2:CTCodelistAttributesRoot)<-[r2]-
  (n3:CTCodelistRoot)
WHERE n1.name = $neodash_ctcodelistattributesvalue_name
MATCH
  (n3)-[r10:HAS_TERM]->(subm_val:CTCodelistTerm)-[r12:HAS_TERM_ROOT]->(n6:CTTermRoot)
WHERE subm_val.submission_value IN $neodash_subval
WITH n3, subm_val, n6, r10
ORDER BY r10.start_date
WITH n3, subm_val, n6, collect({s: r10.start_date, e: r10.end_date}) AS ivs
WITH n3, subm_val, n6, reduce(acc = [], iv IN ivs | CASE WHEN size(acc) > 0 AND (acc[-1].e IS NULL OR iv.s <= acc[-1].e) THEN acc[0..size(acc)-1] + [{s: acc[-1].s, e: CASE WHEN acc[-1].e IS NULL OR iv.e IS NULL THEN null WHEN iv.e > acc[-1].e THEN iv.e ELSE acc[-1].e END}] ELSE acc + [iv] END) AS periods
UNWIND periods AS m
WITH n3, subm_val, n6, m.s AS sv_start, m.e AS sv_end
MATCH (n6)-[:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->(:CTTermAttributesRoot)-[hist_ver:HAS_VERSION]->(hist_val:CTTermAttributesValue)
WHERE coalesce(hist_ver.end_date, datetime('9999-12-31T00:00:00Z')) > sv_start
  AND hist_ver.start_date < coalesce(sv_end, datetime('9999-12-31T00:00:00Z'))
WITH DISTINCT subm_val, n6, n3, hist_ver, coalesce(hist_val.concept_id, n6.uid) AS TermCode
OPTIONAL MATCH(n6)<-[r17:HAS_SELECTED_TERM]-(context:CTTermContext)-[r19:HAS_SELECTED_CODELIST]->(n3)
OPTIONAL MATCH (context)<-[r20]-(term_context)

OPTIONAL MATCH (term_context)<-[:CONTAINS_ACTIVITY_ITEM]-(act_inst:ActivityInstanceValue)
OPTIONAL MATCH (term_context)<-[:ITEM_REF]-(odm_item_group:OdmItemGroupValue)
OPTIONAL MATCH (odm_item_group)<-[:ITEM_GROUP_REF]-(odm_form:OdmFormValue)
OPTIONAL MATCH (term_context)<-[:HAS_DATASET_VARIABLE]-(:DatasetInstance)<-[:HAS_INSTANCE]-(dataset:Dataset)
OPTIONAL MATCH (term_context)<-[:HAS_INSTANCE]-(sponsor_var:DatasetVariable)
OPTIONAL MATCH (term_context)<-[:HAS_TEXT_FIELD|HAS_BOOLEAN_FIELD|HAS_ARRAY_FIELD|HAS_INT_FIELD|HAS_TIME_FIELD]-(field_study:StudyValue)
OPTIONAL MATCH (term_context)<-[:HAS_STUDY_EPOCH]-(epoch_study:StudyValue)
OPTIONAL MATCH (term_context)-[:LATEST]->(aic_val:ActivityInstanceClassValue)

// version of term_context itself, where it's a versioned Value node (e.g. OdmItemValue, ConceptValue subtypes)
OPTIONAL MATCH ()-[tc_ver:HAS_VERSION]->(term_context)

// version of the resolved parent/context node
OPTIONAL MATCH ()-[act_inst_ver:HAS_VERSION]->(act_inst)
OPTIONAL MATCH ()-[odm_item_group_ver:HAS_VERSION]->(odm_item_group)
OPTIONAL MATCH ()-[aic_val_ver:HAS_VERSION]->(aic_val)
OPTIONAL MATCH ()-[field_study_ver:HAS_VERSION]->(field_study)
OPTIONAL MATCH ()-[epoch_study_ver:HAS_VERSION]->(epoch_study)

WITH subm_val, term_context, hist_ver, TermCode,
     act_inst, odm_item_group, odm_form, dataset, sponsor_var, field_study, epoch_study, aic_val,
     tc_ver, act_inst_ver, odm_item_group_ver, aic_val_ver, field_study_ver, epoch_study_ver,
  CASE
    WHEN term_context IS NULL THEN 'Not used'
    WHEN 'ActivityItem' IN labels(term_context) THEN 'Activity Item'
    WHEN 'OdmItemValue' IN labels(term_context) THEN 'ODM Item'
    WHEN 'OdmItemGroupValue' IN labels(term_context) THEN 'ODM Item Group'
    WHEN 'ActivityInstanceClassRoot' IN labels(term_context) THEN 'Activity Instance Class'
    WHEN 'StudyField' IN labels(term_context) THEN 'Study Field'
    WHEN 'StudyEpoch' IN labels(term_context) THEN 'Study Epoch'
    WHEN 'SponsorModelDatasetVariableInstance' IN labels(term_context) THEN 'Sponsor Model Dataset Variable'
    WHEN 'DatasetVariableInstance' IN labels(term_context) THEN 'Dataset Variable'
    WHEN 'UnitDefinitionValue' IN labels(term_context) THEN 'Unit Definition'
    WHEN 'PharmaceuticalProductValue' IN labels(term_context) THEN 'Pharmaceutical Product'
    WHEN 'MedicinalProductValue' IN labels(term_context) THEN 'Medicinal Product'
    WHEN 'TemplateParameterTermValue' IN labels(term_context) THEN 'Template Parameter Term'
    WHEN 'ConceptValue' IN labels(term_context) THEN 'Simple Concept'
    ELSE labels(term_context)[0]
  END AS UsedIn,
  CASE
    WHEN 'ActivityItem' IN labels(term_context) THEN act_inst.name
    WHEN 'OdmItemValue' IN labels(term_context) THEN
      CASE WHEN odm_item_group IS NULL THEN 'Not in any Item Group'
           WHEN odm_form IS NULL THEN odm_item_group.name
           ELSE odm_form.name + ' / ' + odm_item_group.name END
    WHEN 'SponsorModelDatasetVariableInstance' IN labels(term_context) THEN sponsor_var.uid
    WHEN 'DatasetVariableInstance' IN labels(term_context) THEN dataset.uid
    WHEN 'StudyField' IN labels(term_context) THEN field_study.study_id_prefix + ' / ' + term_context.field_name
    WHEN 'StudyEpoch' IN labels(term_context) THEN epoch_study.study_id_prefix + ' / ' + term_context.name
    WHEN 'ActivityInstanceClassRoot' IN labels(term_context) THEN aic_val.name
    ELSE COALESCE(term_context.name, term_context.oid, term_context.uid)
  END AS UsedInContext,
  tc_ver.version AS UsedInVersion,
  COALESCE(act_inst_ver.version, odm_item_group_ver.version, aic_val_ver.version,
           field_study_ver.version, epoch_study_ver.version) AS UsedInContextVersion,
  CASE
    WHEN act_inst IS NOT NULL THEN 'ActivityInstance'
    WHEN odm_form IS NOT NULL THEN 'OdmForm / OdmItemGroup'
    WHEN odm_item_group IS NOT NULL THEN 'OdmItemGroup'
    WHEN dataset IS NOT NULL THEN 'Dataset'
    WHEN sponsor_var IS NOT NULL THEN 'DatasetVariable'
    WHEN field_study IS NOT NULL THEN 'Study'
    WHEN epoch_study IS NOT NULL THEN 'Study'
    WHEN aic_val IS NOT NULL THEN 'ActivityInstanceClassValue'
    WHEN term_context IS NOT NULL THEN labels(term_context)[0]
    ELSE null
  END AS UsedInContextType
WITH hist_ver.version AS TermVersion, subm_val.submission_value AS SubmissionValue, TermCode,
       UsedIn, CASE WHEN UsedIn='Activity Item' THEN 'NA' ELSE UsedInVersion END AS UsedInVersion, UsedInContext, UsedInContextVersion, UsedInContextType
RETURN DISTINCT
       TermVersion, SubmissionValue, TermCode AS `C-code`,
       UsedIn, UsedInVersion, UsedInContext, UsedInContextVersion, UsedInContextType
ORDER BY SubmissionValue, TermVersion, UsedIn, UsedInVersion DESC, UsedInContext, UsedInContextVersion DESC

reports.title: Terms in $neodash_ctcodelistattributesvalue_name - Package : $neodash_pck_date
reports.query:
MATCH (ct_package:CTPackage) WHERE ct_package.name = $neodash_pck_date
MATCH
  (n1:CTCodelistAttributesValue)<-[r1:HAS_VERSION]-
  (n2:CTCodelistAttributesRoot)<-[r2]-
  (n3:CTCodelistRoot),
  (n3)<-[r3:HAS_CODELIST]-
  (catalogue:CTCatalogue)-[r4:CONTAINS_PACKAGE]->
  (ct_package)-[r5:CONTAINS_CODELIST]->
  (ct_pack_cl:CTPackageCodelist)-[r6:CONTAINS_TERM]->
  (ct_pack_term:CTPackageTerm)-[r7:CONTAINS_ATTRIBUTES]->
  (n8:CTTermAttributesValue),
  (ct_pack_cl)-[r8:CONTAINS_ATTRIBUTES]->(n1)
WHERE n1.name = $neodash_ctcodelistattributesvalue_name AND r1.version = $neodash_cl_id
MATCH
  (n3)-[r10:HAS_TERM]->(subm_val:CTCodelistTerm)<-[r11:CONTAINS_SUBMISSION_VALUE]-(ct_pack_term),
  (subm_val)-[r12:HAS_TERM_ROOT]->(n6:CTTermRoot)-[r13:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->
  (n7:CTTermAttributesRoot)-[r14:HAS_VERSION]->(n8)
OPTIONAL MATCH (n6)<-[r16:CONTAINS_TERM]-(lib_term:Library)
RETURN DISTINCT
  coalesce(subm_val.submission_value, '') AS `Submission Value`,
  coalesce(n8.concept_id, '') AS `C-code`,
  coalesce(n8.preferred_term, '') AS `Preferred Term`,
  apoc.text.join(coalesce(n8.synonyms, []), '; ') AS Synonyms,
  coalesce(n8.definition, '') AS Definition,
  coalesce(r14.version, '') AS `Term Version`,
  coalesce(r14.status, '') AS `Term Status`,
  CASE
    WHEN r14.start_date IS NOT NULL THEN apoc.temporal.format(r14.start_date, "yyyy-MM-dd")
    ELSE ''
  END AS `Start Date`,
  coalesce(lib_term.name, '') AS `Term Owner`

UNION

MATCH
  (n1:CTCodelistAttributesValue)<-[r1:HAS_VERSION]-
  (n2:CTCodelistAttributesRoot)<-[r2]-
  (n3:CTCodelistRoot)
WHERE $neodash_pck_date = '(none)'
  AND n1.name = $neodash_ctcodelistattributesvalue_name AND r1.version = $neodash_cl_id
  AND NOT EXISTS { MATCH (:CTPackageCodelist)-[:CONTAINS_ATTRIBUTES]->(n1) }
MATCH
  (n3)-[r10:HAS_TERM]->(subm_val:CTCodelistTerm)-[r12:HAS_TERM_ROOT]->
  (n6:CTTermRoot)-[r13:HAS_ATTRIBUTES_ROOT]->
  (n7:CTTermAttributesRoot)-[r14:HAS_VERSION]->(n8:CTTermAttributesValue)
WHERE r10.end_date IS NULL AND r14.end_date IS NULL
OPTIONAL MATCH (n6)<-[r16:CONTAINS_TERM]-(lib_term:Library)
RETURN DISTINCT
  coalesce(subm_val.submission_value, '') AS `Submission Value`,
  coalesce(n8.concept_id, '') AS `C-code`,
  coalesce(n8.preferred_term, '') AS `Preferred Term`,
  apoc.text.join(coalesce(n8.synonyms, []), '; ') AS Synonyms,
  coalesce(n8.definition, '') AS Definition,
  coalesce(r14.version, '') AS `Term Version`,
  coalesce(r14.status, '') AS `Term Status`,
  CASE
    WHEN r14.start_date IS NOT NULL THEN apoc.temporal.format(r14.start_date, "yyyy-MM-dd")
    ELSE ''
  END AS `Start Date`,
  coalesce(lib_term.name, '') AS `Term Owner`
